name: Alessandro Costa
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: A flyweight who built his record on the Mexican regional scene (17-5; 5-3 UFC; age 31 in our data) and is on a three-fight finishing streak in 2026: R2 TKO of Stewart Nicoll, R1 TKO of Matt Schnell on nine days' notice, and an R2 rear-naked choke of Cody Durden at UFC 329. He now gets a rematch with Amir Albazi, who knocked him out in R3 in his 2022 UFC debut.

how_they_fight.Striking: Counter-puncher with power: overhand rights against Schnell and hooks against Durden (Cageside). About 0.8 knockdowns per 15; seven KO/TKO wins. Our data has him landing 19 of 23 against Schnell. Throws spinning kicks. Output is moderate (about 3.5 a minute).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Seven submission wins, six of them in R1 on the regional scene. Finishes from the back: body triangle to RNC against Durden. Swept Alden Coria with a kimura and took his back (Cageside). Takedown defense is strong (about 81%); Cageside noted it held up early against Albazi.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped three times: Uriel Cossio R2 (2016), Albazi R3 (2022: dropped in R2 and R3, controlled for 354 seconds in our data) and Coria R3 (2025, hampered by a foot injury per Cageside). Also lost a decision to Steve Erceg, who held him for 389 seconds in our data.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Starts fast, struggles late. Fourteen stoppage wins: nine in R1, four in R2, one in R3 (2021). Both UFC stoppage losses came in R3 after he'd lost the earlier rounds. His one five-round fight (2020) was a decision win. His recent wins all ended inside two rounds.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Opportunistic; says he knew the Durden finish was 'just a matter of time' once he got position. Wants a ranked opponent next (Cageside). Willing to take short-notice fights.

patterns: R1-R2 finisher: 13 of 14 stoppage wins inside two rounds
Both UFC stoppage losses in R3
concerns: Previous knockout loss to this opponent
Late rounds against a patient grappler
keys_to_beat: Survive his first two rounds, then wrestle him in R3
Stay patient and don't walk onto his counter right
Clinch and control him against the fence

news.text: Booked in a rematch with Amir Albazi on the Qatar prelims.
Submitted Cody Durden with a rear-naked choke at 2:19 of R2 at UFC 329.
Stopped Matt Schnell at 2:32 of R1 at a catchweight after taking the fight on nine days' notice.
